logp.method_description: 1-Octanol saturated with water and water saturated with1-octanol were prepared by vigorous stirring for 24 h. Each iridium complex was dissolved in 1-octanol saturated with water. This stock solution was added to an equal volume of water saturated with 1-octanol, and the mixture was shaken for 5 min. Then, 1-octanol layer was carefully separated from the layer of water. The absorbance at 485 nm of the stock solution (AS) and the 1-octanol solution (AOC) after partitioning were measured. The log PO/W values were determined by using the following equation: log PO/W = log (COC / Cw) = log ((COC / (CS – COC)) = log ((AOC / (AS – AOC)) where COC and CW, and Cs were the concentration of iridium complex in 1-octanol and water after partitioning, and the concentration of iridium complex in the stock solution, respectively.
